description: This Java class 'JsonParserHelper' provides utility methods for extracting and parsing various data types and complex objects from JSON elements. It includes methods for handling primitives, arrays, dates, times, locale parameters, and validation, primarily used within the Fineract core API serialization layer.

classes.name: JsonParserHelper
classes.description: A utility/helper class for extracting and converting JSON attribute values into Java data types, with support for locale-specific parsing, date/time parsing, arrays, and validation.

methods.name: parameterExists
methods.description: Checks whether a specific parameter exists within a given JSON element.

methods.name: parameterHasValue
methods.description: Checks whether a parameter in the JSON object has a non-blank or non-empty value.

methods.name: extractBooleanNamed
methods.description: Extracts a boolean value of a named parameter from a JSON object, updating detected parameters set.

methods.name: extractLongNamed
methods.description: Extracts a Long value of a named parameter from a JSON object, updating passed parameters set.

methods.name: extractStringNamed
methods.description: Extracts a String value of a named parameter from a JSON object, updating passed parameters set.

methods.name: extractBigDecimalWithLocaleNamed
methods.description: Extracts a BigDecimal value with locale-aware parsing based on a specified parameter name.

methods.name: extractBigDecimalNamed
methods.description: Extracts a BigDecimal from a JSON object, considering locale-specific number formats.

methods.name: extractIntegerWithLocaleNamed
methods.description: Extracts an Integer value considering locale-specific number formatting.

methods.name: extractIntegerNamed
methods.description: Extracts an Integer value considering locale-specific formatting.

methods.name: extractIntegerSansLocaleNamed
methods.description: Extracts an Integer from a primitive string, assuming unformatted numeric string.

methods.name: extractDateFormatParameter
methods.description: Extracts the date format string parameter from a JSON object.

methods.name: extractTimeFormatParameter
methods.description: Extracts the time format string parameter from a JSON object.

methods.name: extractMonthDayFormatParameter
methods.description: Extracts the month-day format string parameter from a JSON object.

methods.name: extractLocaleParameter
methods.description: Extracts the locale setting from a JSON object.

methods.name: extractArrayNamed
methods.description: Extracts an array of strings from a JSON object parameter.

methods.name: extractJsonArrayNamed
methods.description: Retrieves a JSON array element by parameter name.

methods.name: extractJsonObjectNamed
methods.description: Retrieves a JSON object by parameter name.

methods.name: extractLocalDateAsArrayNamed
methods.description: Extracts a LocalDate from a JSON array (e.g., [year, month, day]) for a named parameter.

methods.name: extractMonthDayNamed
methods.description: Extracts a MonthDay object from a parameter with optional date format and locale.

methods.name: extractLocalDateNamed
methods.description: Extracts a LocalDate from a JSON object, considering optional date format and locale.

methods.name: extractLocalTimeNamed
methods.description: Extracts a LocalTime from a JSON object, given a format and locale.

methods.name: extractLocalDateTimeNamed
methods.description: Extracts a LocalDateTime from a JSON object considering date/time format and locale.

methods.name: extractLocalTimeNamed
methods.description: Extracts a LocalTime from JSON with a specified format and locale.

methods.name: extractLocalDateTimeNamed
methods.description: Extracts a LocalDateTime with support for custom format, locale, and error handling.

methods.name: convertFrom
methods.description: Converts a date string to LocalDate using a specific date format and locale.

methods.name: convertDateTimeFrom
methods.description: Converts a datetime string into LocalDateTime with given format and locale, validating format.

methods.name: validateDateFormatAndLocale
methods.description: Validates presence of dateFormat and locale parameters.

methods.name: convertToInteger
methods.description: Converts a locale-formatted number string into an Integer, with validation.

methods.name: convertToIntegerSanLocale
methods.description: Converts an unformatted numeric string into Integer.

methods.name: convertFrom
methods.description: Converts a locale-formatted string into BigDecimal.

methods.name: localeFromString
methods.description: Parses a locale string (e.g., en_US) into a Locale object, with validation.

methods.name: localeFrom
methods.description: Creates a Locale object from language, country, and variant codes, with validation.

methods.name: extractLocaleValue
methods.description: Extracts a Locale object from a JSON object if present.
